correctness.rationale: Shifting the distinct ray basis vectors forward and fixing the complement gives propagation ≤R, initial projection 1 and final projection 1−p for rank-one p. The image unitary has index −1 by the stated kernel-minus-cokernel convention. Thus [p]=0 in K₀(A), the six-term sequence gives canonical K₀(A)≅K₀(Q) and injective K₁(A)→K₁(Q), and m↦−m[u] splits the index. For Property A, Guo–Li–Zhang–Zhu Theorem 1.1 and quotient permanence give dimension at most one. The source's discrete hypothesis is harmless: finite balls make every point isolated, and replacing d by ceil(d) gives uniform discreteness while preserving bounded geometry, the controlled sets, Property A, the algebra, and the ray. To check the nonseparable dimension-zero step, take a single contractive order-zero finite-dimensional approximation including 1. The positive image h of the finite-dimensional unit dominates the approximation to 1, so h is close to 1 and invertible. Multiplying the order-zero map by h⁻¹ gives its supporting unital homomorphism, hence approximations in unital finite-dimensional subalgebras. Matrix unitaries then approximate by finite-dimensional unitaries via polar decomposition and are homotopic to 1. This contradicts the index class. Without Property A, nuclearity of Q would give nuclearity of A by extension permanence with the compact ideal, contrary to the nuclearity characterization. König's lemma applies to the locally finite connected Rips graph. No numerical experiment is needed.
residual_risks: The dimension-one upper bound is an external preprint input, not re-proved in the frozen record. The review verified the actual theorem and scope, not independent refereeing of that preprint.

evidence: Guo et al. state the trichotomy for A, not Q. Li–Willett construct a proper isometry in the limit image Φω(A) for every positive-asdim space (HTML offsets 28520–32019). Špakula–Willett show ghosts are in every nonprincipal limit kernel (PDF pp. 34–35, offsets 108950–112478). Compacts are norm limits of finitely supported matrices and hence are ghosts.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Thus Φω(A) is a quotient of Q and has a proper isometry for all positive asdim, not merely for spaces with rays. A dimension-zero unital algebra is locally finite-dimensional and finite; its quotients have dimension zero. The limit image therefore gives the sharp lower bound for this broader class.

evidence: The Li–Willett shift omits just the first basis vector, giving −1 and a vanishing compact K₀ map by equivalence of 1 and 1−p. Separately, the Li–Willett/Špakula–Willett proper-isometry quotient supplies a lower bound for all positive asdim; the full-algebra bound gives the matching upper bound by permanence. If Property A fails, nuclearity permanence with K forces Q nonnuclear. For asdim zero the full-algebra dimension-zero case gives the corona upper bound zero directly.

The index and relative K-groups themselves use only the earlier shift's rank-one defect and the standard index sequence.

originality.rationale: A distinct exact combined statement was not established by the bounded search, but the important conclusions follow mechanically from specific earlier constructions. Li–Willett already give the unilateral shift, identity elsewhere, on a coarsely embedded copy of N; the same controlled matrix uses only a bound on adjacent steps. Its rank-one defect is inherent, and the two K-theory conclusions are the textbook six-term computation of that defect. More decisively, Li–Willett's proof of Theorem 2.2 gives a nonprincipal limit-operator image containing a proper isometry whenever asdim is positive, and Špakula–Willett Proposition 8.2 makes that image a quotient of the corona, since all compact operators are ghosts. This already gives the dimension-zero obstruction for the larger class. Putting it together with the explicitly credited full-algebra dimension upper bound and standard permanence gives the same sharp corona dimension on a larger domain; the new packaging does not establish a distinct result.
residual_risks: No assertion is made about first publication of the assembled statement. The judgment rests on explicit prior constructions plus standard deductions, not lack of an exact search hit or unavailability of a source.

value.rationale: The geometric index is useful for explaining the corona and the statement is correct. But the ray shift is the existing shift construction with its immediate propagation condition, its relative group calculation is a textbook consequence of the defect, and the sharp dimension is mechanically implied in the larger positive-asdim class. The frozen statement does not establish a separate new boundary, an independent computation of the full-algebra K-groups, or another scientifically valuable claim that survives this comparison.
residual_risks: This is a judgment about incremental mathematical value, not the expository utility of writing these consequences together.
